ner does not guarantee; W-10 loses cancellation; W-12/audit hard stop has the triage write exception. Probe races and a late failure can invalidate readiness or undo completion. AM4: FAIL. The current one-shot implementation does wait for process completion before yielding, confirming P8. The proposed adapter is explicitly line-live, and FR-MCP-HVPIPE-008-AC003 is a good discriminating one-line-then-block test. The specified StreamReviewerOutput activity nevertheless cannot flush that single line on a timer without another line or exit; the end-to-end claim fails its own criterion.

AM5: FAIL. S-29, R-19/R-20 and I-13 explicitly preserve the append-only ledger and indefinite evidence retention until explicit removal. No audit purge is authorized. All new entity mutations are intended to use AuditLedgerGuard. The actual FileHvIncident ordering permits an external write before that guard, and removal/read contracts are incomplete. These are executable gaps, not an objection to the stated retention policy.

AM7: FAIL. The foundation at base and HEAD hashes to 6E5D4F418E78CF9A76AB366F64D4F24002C09E3C3F024502ED89D77C6E77295E, matching the amendment. The document is unchanged from develop 36783b79. AM8: FAIL. Exact store/catalog comparison passes: 21 FR, 21 TR, 21 TEST records, all pending; 114 distinct FR behavior criteria, each with named tests; the TEST projections repeat those 114 criteria and each TR has its catalog criterion. Titles, descriptions, criterion ids/text and 21 mapping groups (42 directed edges) match; every mapping edge has its TEST coverage statement. Equality does not make the behavior provable: response closure and removal criteria conflict with their units, and several necessary concurrency/crash criteria are absent. The complete real-binding phase allocation is not proven (U02). No product tests were executed or represented as passing.
